set.body: Implement executable Component/ForEach/Switch descriptions, headless mounts and live read-only Inputs. Preserve per-key draft state through replacement/reorder, remount on key/type/dependency/ordinary-owner change, reject duplicates atomically, cover scoped rollback and structural failures. Add independent reconciliation oracle and JVM/Native checks with bounded review. Rendering, virtualization, events/change delivery and explicit reparent outlets remain separate.
set.title: C1.5b live Inputs and keyed headless reconciliation
